description: This file contains implementations of cryptographic hash functions including MD5, SHA-1, SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512, with functions for processing, padding, and finalizing hashes. It also includes platform-specific includes and macro definitions for byte order handling.

classes.name: MD5
classes.description: Implementation of MD5 hash algorithm with methods for updating, finalizing, and operator overloading for string input.

classes.name: SHA1
classes.description: Implementation of SHA-1 hash algorithm with methods for processing message blocks, padding, and operator overloading.

classes.name: SHA224
classes.description: Implementation of SHA-224 hash algorithm, a truncated version of SHA-256, with methods for processing, padding, and operator overloading.

classes.name: SHA256
classes.description: Implementation of SHA-256 hash algorithm with methods for processing message blocks, padding, and operator overloading.

classes.name: SHA384
classes.description: Implementation of SHA-384 hash algorithm, a truncated version of SHA-512, with methods for processing, padding, and operator overloading.

classes.name: SHA512
classes.description: Implementation of SHA-512 hash algorithm with methods for processing message blocks, padding, and operator overloading.

methods.name: ProcessMessageBlock
methods.description: Processes a 512-bit message block for MD5 or SHA-1 algorithms.

methods.name: PadMessage
methods.description: Pads the message according to the hash standard before final hash computation.

methods.name: CloseContext
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation, processes remaining data, and produces the digest.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Feeds data into the hash context for processing.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the hash context to initial state for new hashing.
